LanguageData.MFV_MagicTorchLamp.label: magic torch lamp
LanguageData.MFV_MagicTorchLamp.description: An enchanted torch built around a fire arcane focus. It lights an area without needing refueling, and produces a small amount of heat.
LanguageData.MFV_MagicTorchWallLamp.label: magic wall torch lamp
LanguageData.MFV_MagicTorchWallLamp.description: An enchanted wall-mounted torch built around a fire arcane focus. It lights an area without needing refueling, and produces a small amount of heat.
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarGate.label: planar gate
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarGate.description: A stabilized arcane threshold tuned to folds in nearby space. Pawns can enter it to traverse into the Aether Wild or Cinderdeep.
LanguageData.MFV_GemstoneVein.label: gemstone vein
LanguageData.MFV_GemstoneVein.description: A small mixed seam of crystalline material. Mining it may produce rough gemstone chunks.
LanguageData.MFV_PhaseStone.label: phase stone
LanguageData.MFV_PhaseStone.description: A pale planar stone that seems to sit slightly out of alignment with ordinary space. Mining it leaves behind phase stone chunks.
LanguageData.MFV_Voidglass.label: voidglass
LanguageData.MFV_Voidglass.description: A dark, glassy planar formation that bends light along its facets. Mining it leaves behind voidglass chunks.
LanguageData.MFV_AdvancedArcaneResearchBench.label: advanced arcane research bench
LanguageData.MFV_AdvancedArcaneResearchBench.descript: An elaborate arcane laboratory bench with stabilized instruments for higher-order ritual, planar, and enchantment research.
LanguageData.MFV_AlchemyTable.label: alchemy table
LanguageData.MFV_AlchemyTable.description: A practical worktable for steeping herbs, grinding reagents, and preparing simple magical compounds.
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneForge.label: arcane forge
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneForge.description: An enchantment bench with stabilizing clamps, focusing channels, and warded toolheads for binding durable magic into weapons, armor, and other high-value gear.
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneResearchBench.label: arcane research bench
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneResearchBench.description: A simple workbench for recording arcane observations, comparing spell structures, and conducting early magical research.
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneSpire.label: arcane spire
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneSpire.description: A resonant arcane conductor that stabilizes enchantment work when arranged around an arcane forge.
LanguageData.MFV_LapidaryBench.label: lapidary bench
LanguageData.MFV_LapidaryBench.description: A compact workbench with clamps, abrasives, and polishing tools for breaking and cutting rough gemstones.
LanguageData.MFV_PapyrusPress.label: papyrus press
LanguageData.MFV_PapyrusPress.description: A simple pressing station for soaking, flattening, and drying plant fibers into papyrus sheets.
LanguageData.MFV_ParchmenteryBench.label: parchmentery bench
LanguageData.MFV_ParchmenteryBench.description: A prepared workbench for scraping, stretching, and drying leather into durable parchment sheets.
LanguageData.MFV_ScribingTable.label: scribing table
LanguageData.MFV_ScribingTable.description: A careful writing station for preparing spell scrolls from papyrus and parchment.
LanguageData.MFV_MagicHeater.label: magic heater
LanguageData.MFV_MagicHeater.description: An enchanted heater built around a fire arcane focus. It warms indoor spaces without electricity and stops pushing heat once the room is comfortable.
LanguageData.MFV_FineMagicHeater.label: fine magic heater
LanguageData.MFV_FineMagicHeater.description: An enchanted heater built around fire-aspected fittings. It warms indoor spaces faster than a standard magic heater, while still stopping once the room is comfortable.
LanguageData.MFV_ExquisiteMagicHeater.label: exquisite magic heater
LanguageData.MFV_ExquisiteMagicHeater.description: An enchanted heater built around reinforced fire-aspected fittings. It strongly warms indoor spaces, while still stopping once the room is comfortable.
LanguageData.MFV_MagicPassiveCooler.label: magic passive cooler
LanguageData.MFV_MagicPassiveCooler.description: An enchanted cooler built around a water arcane focus. It cools indoor spaces without electricity or refueling, though it is not efficient enough to refrigerate food.
LanguageData.MFV_FineMagicPassiveCooler.label: fine magic passive cooler
LanguageData.MFV_FineMagicPassiveCooler.description: An enchanted cooler built around water-aspected fittings. It cools indoor spaces without electricity or refueling, and can draw the air colder than a standard passive cooler.
LanguageData.MFV_ExquisiteMagicPassiveCooler.label: exquisite magic passive cooler
LanguageData.MFV_ExquisiteMagicPassiveCooler.descript: An enchanted cooler built around reinforced water-aspected fittings. It cools indoor spaces without electricity or refueling, and can keep a room below freezing in favorable conditions.
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneInk.label: arcane ink
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneInk.description: A concentrated magical ink prepared from potent herbs. It holds runic notation cleanly enough for scrollwork and other ritual writing.
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneTreasureChest.label: arcane treasure chest
LanguageData.MFV_GreaterArcaneTreasureChest.label: greater arcane treasure chest
LanguageData.MFV_GrandArcaneTreasureChest.label: grand arcane treasure chest
LanguageData.MFV_GrandArcaneTreasureChest.description: A sealed cache of unusually dense magical spoils. The bindings around it hum with layered promise and risk.
LanguageData.MFV_ExoticHerbs.label: exotic herbs
LanguageData.MFV_ExoticHerbs.description: Freshly cut magical herbs with pungent oils and useful occult properties. They can be refined into alchemical reagents and arcane inks.
LanguageData.MFV_GemstoneDust.label: gemstone dust
LanguageData.MFV_GemstoneDust.description: Fine crystalline dust collected while cutting gemstones. Alchemists use it to stabilize arcane ink for scrollwork.
LanguageData.MFV_FireArcaneFocus.label: fire arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_FireArcaneFocus.description: A ruby focus prepared to hold stable fire-aspected arcane charge. It is useful for heat, flame, light, and fire enchantments.
LanguageData.MFV_WaterArcaneFocus.label: water arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_WaterArcaneFocus.description: A sapphire focus prepared to hold stable water-aspected arcane charge. It is useful for cooling, flow, protection, and water enchantments.
LanguageData.MFV_EarthArcaneFocus.label: earth arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_EarthArcaneFocus.description: An emerald focus prepared to hold stable earth-aspected arcane charge. It is useful for stone, growth, stability, and earth enchantments.
LanguageData.MFV_AirArcaneFocus.label: air arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_AirArcaneFocus.description: A topaz focus prepared to hold stable air-aspected arcane charge. It is useful for wind, lightning, conduction, and air enchantments.

LanguageData.MFV_FlamingLongsword.label: flaming longsword
LanguageData.MFV_FlamingLongsword.description: A longsword carrying a bound flame enchantment. Its edge burns hot enough to sear flesh and kindle targets while remaining stable in its wielder's hand.
LanguageData.MFV_ZephyrSpear.label: Zephyr Spear
LanguageData.MFV_ZephyrSpear.description: A spear carrying a bound air enchantment. Its point rides sudden pressure shifts, striking with uncanny reach and snapping gusts.
LanguageData.MFV_TidebreakerMace.label: Tidebreaker Mace
LanguageData.MFV_TidebreakerMace.description: A mace carrying a bound water enchantment. Each impact lands with a cold, crashing weight that chills armor and flesh alike.
LanguageData.MFV_StonefallMace.label: Stonefall Mace
LanguageData.MFV_StonefallMace.description: A mace carrying a bound earth enchantment. Its head falls with unnatural certainty, adding crushing force to clean hits.
LanguageData.MFV_Papyrus.label: papyrus
LanguageData.MFV_Papyrus.description: Pressed plant fiber sheets suitable for simple notes, formulae, and low-order scrollwork.
LanguageData.MFV_Parchment.label: parchment
LanguageData.MFV_Parchment.description: Pressed and dried sheets prepared for magical notation, ritual drafts, and scrollwork.
LanguageData.MFV_ChunkPhaseStone.label: phase stone chunk
LanguageData.MFV_ChunkPhaseStone.description: A chunk of phase stone from the Aether Wild or Cinderdeep. It can be ground into gemstone dust.
LanguageData.MFV_ChunkVoidglass.label: voidglass chunk
LanguageData.MFV_ChunkVoidglass.description: A chunk of dark planar glass. It can be ground into gemstone dust or refined into void glass for construction.
LanguageData.MFV_VoidGlass.label: void glass
LanguageData.MFV_VoidGlass.description: Refined panes and shards of planar voidglass, darkly translucent and stable enough to build with.
LanguageData.MFV_CinderRose.label: cinder rose
LanguageData.MFV_CinderRose.description: A warm planar bloom cut from a Cinderdeep rosebush. Its ember-red petals make a striking gift, if one can avoid the thorns.
LanguageData.MFV_PhaseStoneWall.label: phase stone wall
LanguageData.MFV_PhaseStoneWall.description: A wall built from refined phase stone. To ordinary bodies it is solid stone, but pawns with the Arcane Gift can slip through its misaligned surface.
LanguageData.MFV_VoidGlassWall.label: void glass wall
LanguageData.MFV_VoidGlassWall.description: An impassable wall made from refined planar void glass. It drinks in light along its dark facets while remaining strong enough to hold up a roof.
LanguageData.MFV_Gun_CrystalLance.label: crystal graser
LanguageData.MFV_Gun_CrystalLance.description: A faceted crystal emitter grown into the frame of an arcane sentinel. It releases a sweeping, high-energy beam that burns through armor and shield fields.
LanguageData.MFV_Gun_RuneBallista.label: stone hurling core
LanguageData.MFV_Gun_RuneBallista.description: A geomantic core fixed into a stone golem's frame. Before each shot, it tears chunks from the ground and hurls one as a crushing boulder.
LanguageData.MFV_Projectile_StoneGolemBoulder.label: hurled boulder
LanguageData.MFV_ClayAutomaton.label: clay automaton
LanguageData.MFV_ClayAutomaton.description: A blunt clay guardian shaped by old warding rites. Its rune-core is simple, but the body is tireless, obedient, and dangerously strong at close range.
LanguageData.MFV_RuneSlasherAutomaton.label: rune-slasher automaton
LanguageData.MFV_RuneSlasherAutomaton.description: A fast guardian frame fitted with crescent blades and guiding runes. It closes distance quickly, then tears at anything that violates its sealed charge.
LanguageData.MFV_FleshGolem.label: flesh golem
LanguageData.MFV_FleshGolem.description: A stitched guardian animated by vital magic and crude command runes. It lumbers into melee, absorbs punishment, and knits torn flesh back together while the fight continues.
LanguageData.MFV_CrystalSentinel.label: crystal sentinel
LanguageData.MFV_CrystalSentinel.description: A narrow guardian automaton built around a charged crystal heart. Its polished focus sweeps a burning crystal beam across intruders before the sentinel advances.
LanguageData.MFV_RuneBallistaConstruct.label: stone golem
LanguageData.MFV_RuneBallistaConstruct.description: A heavy stone guardian designed to hold a corridor or vault approach. It digs chunks from the ground around itself, then hurls the raised stone with crushing force.
LanguageData.MFV_DeepIronGolem.label: deep iron golem
LanguageData.MFV_DeepIronGolem.description: A towering construct forged from dark deep iron and animated by a bound force rune. It is slow and ponderous, but its rune drinks in violent energy until it can harden into a shield or erupt in a crushing wave.
LanguageData.MFV_Skeleton.label: skeleton
LanguageData.MFV_Skeleton.description: A brittle undead guardian assembled from grave-bone and held upright by necromantic command. It has no hunger, fear, or comfort, and exists only briefly to fight for its summoner.
LanguageData.Plant_MFV_ExoticHerbs.label: exotic herbs
LanguageData.Plant_MFV_ExoticHerbs.description: A cultivated magical herb used as a flexible organic base for alchemical preparations, inks, and other arcane reagents.

LanguageData.Plant_MFV_PlanarK.label: cinder rosebush
LanguageData.Plant_MFV_PlanarK.description: A thorny rosebush from Cinderdeep that grows ember-warm blooms. Harvesting it can draw blood.
